'''Asset R-12''' was a member of the [[The Shroud's syndicate|intelligence network]] that served the independent operative known as [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Asset R-12 attempted to infiltrate [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]]'s inner circle or otherwise carry out direct observation.
